identity.name: UniWese
identity.mission: Create a mobile-first college application platform that feels organic, trustworthy, and distinctly Indian yet globally aspirational. Avoid the sterile 'medical' look of standard green apps. Aim for 'Growth & Opportunity'.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix academic prestige with consumer app fluidity.
Thumb-Driven Design: Primary actions must be within the 'thumb zone' (bottom 40% of screen).
Content is King: Data (deadlines, scores) must be scanned, not read.
Green is Growth: Use the brand green (#338038) for progress and success, not just decoration.
Soft Modernity: High rounded corners (12px-16px) and deep soft shadows to create a friendly, approachable vibe.

primary.description: Deep vibrant green. Use for Primary Actions (Login, Apply), Active States, and Success Indicators.

colors.tailwind_config_instruction: Update your tailwind.config.js to set 'primary' color to hsl(124, 43%, 35%) which approximates #338038. Set 'radius' to 0.75rem (12px).

bento_grid.description: Use for dashboard summaries. Mix square (1x1) and rectangular (2x1) cards.

mobile_first_rules: Navigation: Use a fixed Bottom Navigation Bar for mobile views (hidden on desktop).
Touch Targets: All interactive elements must be at least 44px height.
Reachability: Place primary 'Floating Action Buttons' or 'Next' buttons at the bottom right or bottom center.

buttons.primary: bg-[#338038] hover:bg-[#2a6e30] text-white rounded-xl h-12 px-6 font-bold shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-xl h-12 px-6 font-medium shadow-sm

cards.base: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-5 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow

inputs.base: bg-white border-slate-200 focus:border-[#338038] focus:ring-[#338038]/20 rounded-xl h-12 px-4 text-base shadow-sm

navigation.bottom_bar: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white border-t border-slate-100 h-16 flex items-center justify-around z-50 pb-safe shadow-[0_-4px_6px_-1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]
navigation.bottom_bar_item: flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-400 data-[active=true]:text-[#338038]

textures.noise: Use a subtle SVG noise overlay at 2-3% opacity on solid green backgrounds to prevent flatness.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Use 'filled' style for active bottom nav states, 'outline' for inactive.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE THEME: Go to /app/frontend/src/index.css and update the --primary color variable to '124 43% 35%' (HSL for #338038). Update --radius to '0.75rem'.
2. MOBILE FIRST: Always verify layouts on mobile width (375px-430px). Use 'hidden md:block' for desktop-only elements.
3. NAVIGATION: Implement a 'BottomNav' component for the mobile layout containing: Home, Colleges, Applications, Community, Profile.
4. STUDENT PROFILE: Use the 'Bento Grid' layout for the Student Dashboard to show 'Application Status', 'Upcoming Deadlines', and 'Recommended Colleges'.
5. COLLEGE CARDS: Design the 'College Directory' using the 'cards.base' style. Include a prominent 'Apply Now' button using 'buttons.primary'.
6. FORMS: Use 'shadcn/ui' form components but override the styling with 'inputs.base'. Ensure labels are uppercase and bold ('typography.usage.labels').
7. LOGIN: Recreate the login screen exactly using the green branding and rounded inputs.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': Do not use generic gradients or default blue colors.
Interaction: Add 'active:scale-95' to all buttons for tactile feedback.
Empty States: Never leave a list empty. Always show a friendly illustration and a CTA (e.g., 'No applications yet? Start exploring!').
Data-Test-ID: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testing.
